# Shop

A tiny shop used to test the code map. Start at src/index.js.

## Cart

The `Cart` class in `src/cart.ts` extends `Store`; prices go through `formatPrice`.
See [the guide](docs/guide.md) and package.json.

```sh
node src/index.js 42
# not a heading
```

## API

`fetchCart()` lives in src/api/client.js (see https://example.com/src/cart.ts).
